title: Lockheed Skunk Works response to Grusch's testimony

tellings.quote:
notably their response to gush's
testimony was pretty telling they said
questions about uaps are best answered
by the federal government

plain: Lockheed Martin, whose secretive advanced-projects division is called the Skunk Works, answered the 2023 testimony of David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who told Congress about hidden UFO programmes, by saying that "questions about UAPs are best answered by the federal government." UAP stands for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs. Michels tells this himself and calls the reply "pretty telling," because to him a defence company that sends the question back to the government, without denying anything, hints that it knows more.
